scope: First-cell resource-transition audit; captured during ongoing suite. This artifact preserves observed file timestamps, which Git does not preserve. No model inference and no benchmark source edits.
timezone_note: nvidia-smi CSV local timestamps are UTC+08:00; report-derived times below are UTC.
timing_method: Approximate build end = observed report file mtime minus explicitly excluded baseline recording flush minus QA duration; start subtracts build duration. Report formatting/writing and post-timing book-keeping are not separately timestamped, so these are approximate reconstructed boundaries, not original event wall timestamps.
conclusion: GPU allocation dropped by15995MiB just after reconstructed baseline build end and before optimized build. Similar serial evolution calls became roughly twice as fast. First-cell live speedup is confounded by this resource transition; memory monitoring alone does not identify the exiting process or prove causality.
